charts.title: K2-72 c: orbits around K2-72
charts.description: The orbits of K2-72's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-72 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Dressing et al. 2017 (2017AJ....154..207D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DRESSING_ET_AL__2017): P 15.189034 d

charts.title: K2-72 c: its transit
charts.description: K2-72 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (42) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 38337202, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 126 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 2203 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 126 min late; 9-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 734 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
